title: C: TCP Stack (Simulated)
description: Simulate a simplified TCP state machine with states like CLOSED, SYN_SENT, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT.

steps.title: TCP State Machine
steps.description: Define TCP states as an enum: CLOSED, LISTEN, SYN_SENT, SYN_RCVD, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT_1, FIN_WAIT_2, TIME_WAIT, CLOSED. Implement a `tcp_handshake` function that transitions through: CLOSED -> SYN_SENT -> ESTABLISHED (client side). Print each state transition.
hints: Function `const char* state_name(State s)` for printing.
Simulate: send SYN -> receive SYN+ACK -> send ACK.

verification.failureMessage: Simulate TCP handshake through all states
